items.t: Oracle Now Gets “$16 Billion a Year” per Gigawatt, Up From $10 Billion
items.sum: Key TakeawaysOracle says a gigawatt on new AI contracts now brings in $16 billion a year at full ramp, up 60% from $10 billion in October 2025. CFO Hilary Maxson says it’s mainly memory costs passed through cost-plus contracts, so each gigawatt costs more too.
